# Data Source: yet_cloud_runtime

A runtime, by its name — and its server's, when another server has one of that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "yet_cloud_runtime" "office" {
  name = "office-k3s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The runtime's name.

### Optional

- `server_id` (String) The server it runs on: say it when runtimes of that name are on several.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Its id.
- `ingress` (String) The address its environments' records point at.
- `ingress_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a k3s runtime's ingress is on: off for one that runs runners only.
- `pool_id` (String) The pool it is a member of, if any.
- `rack_id` (String) Its server's rack.
- `stack` (String) How it runs.
- `status` (String) How it stands.
- `tunnel` (Boolean) Whether it is behind a Cloudflare tunnel of its own.
- `tunnel_id` (String) Its Cloudflare tunnel, if any.
